name: Delivery

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: '47 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      delivery:
        description: Delivery scope
        type: choice
        default: full
        options: [full, projects-g6-catalog]

permissions: {}
cache-mode: none

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' && 'deliver-projects-g6-catalog' || (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'deliver' || format('deliver-validate-{0}', github.ref)) }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      verdict: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.verdict }}
      g6_plan: ${{ steps.g6_qualify.outputs.plan }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout CiCd candidate
        id: cicd
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup uv
        id: uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@68559e99cc807c1eb7e9238fd43a15bba460eec2 # v10.3.3
        with:
          version: '0.13.7'
          enable-cache: false

      - name: Checkout Builds objects and tags
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds
          ref: main
          path: references/Hexalith.Builds
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout only narrow delivery fixture tag
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Hexalith/Hexalith.Builds
          ref: refs/tags/v5.1.0
          path: references/Hexalith.Builds
          fetch-depth: 1
          fetch-tags: false
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Validate candidate and modules
        id: validate
        # A failed Builds checkout must still permit a conservative verdict.
        # Its failed step keeps the job red even if validation can continue.
        # !cancelled(), unlike always(), lets a superseded or cancelled run stop.
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' && steps.cicd.outcome == 'success' && steps.uv.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: uv run --locked --script tools/validate.py

      - name: Qualify narrow catalog delivery behavior without secrets
        id: g6_tests
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        run: |
          uv run --locked --script --python 3.12 tools/tests/test_prepare_g6_catalog.py
          uv run --locked --script --python 3.12 tools/tests/test_deliver_g6_catalog.py
          uv run --locked --script --python 3.12 tools/tests/test_delivery_workflow.py

      - name: Bind narrow plan to current exact owner source and reviewed Projects tree
        id: g6_qualify
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' && steps.cicd.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          G6_OWNER_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
          G6_BEHAVIORAL_RESULT: ${{ steps.g6_tests.outcome }}
        run: python3 -I tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py qualify --report g6-qualification.json

      - name: Upload narrow qualification receipt
        if: ${{ always() && inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: projects-g6-qualification
          path: g6-qualification.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

    needs: validate
    concurrency:
      group: deliver-owned-writes
      cancel-in-progress: false
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && (inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && needs.validate.result == 'success' && needs.validate.outputs.g6_plan != '')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    environment: cicd-app
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      DELIVERY_DIRECTORY: ${{ github.workspace }}/.delivery-state-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact qualified narrow owner source
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: .g6-owner
          sparse-checkout: |
            tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py
            tools/delivery_runtime.py
            docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.json
            docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.patch
            .github/actions/prepare-g6-catalog
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Mint only Projects catalog correction token
        id: g6_token
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: Hexalith
          repositories: Hexalith.Projects
          permission-contents: write
          permission-workflows: write

      - name: Deliver exact qualified Projects catalog correction
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        env:
          G6_OWNER_SOURCE: ${{ github.sha }}
          G6_QUALIFICATION: ${{ needs.validate.result }}
          G6_PLAN: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.g6_plan }}
          MODULE_TOKEN: ${{ steps.g6_token.outputs.token }}
        run: python3 -I .g6-owner/tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py deliver --report projects-g6-delivery.json

      - name: Upload narrow delivery receipt
        if: ${{ always() && inputs.delivery == 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: projects-g6-delivery
          path: projects-g6-delivery.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90

      - name: Checkout immutable delivery bootstrap
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' }}
        timeout-minutes: 3
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: 03d130f82366dec8ed70a21a14177ae55ea09ca1
          path: .delivery-bootstrap
          sparse-checkout: |
            tools/delivery_bootstrap.py
            tools/delivery_runtime.py

          submodules: false
          persist-credentials: false

        id: select
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' && always() }}
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          DELIVERY_VERDICT: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.verdict }}
        run: python3 -I .delivery-bootstrap/tools/delivery_bootstrap.py select

      - name: Mint CiCd accepted-ref and freshness token
        timeout-minutes: 1
        id: cicd_token
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' && !cancelled() && steps.select.outputs.ready == 'true' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: Hexalith
          repositories: Hexalith.CiCd
          permission-contents: write
          permission-workflows: write
          permission-actions: read

      - name: Initialize delivery and hourly freshness
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' && !cancelled() }}
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          CICD_TOKEN: ${{ steps.cicd_token.outputs.token }}
        run: python3 -I .delivery-bootstrap/tools/delivery_bootstrap.py initialize

      - name: Check module slot 01 time budget
        id: module_01_budget
        if: ${{ inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' && !cancelled() && steps.select.outputs.slot_01 != '' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: python3 -I .delivery-bootstrap/tools/delivery_bootstrap.py permit --slot 1

      - name: Mint module slot 01 token
        timeout-minutes: 1

        if: ${{ inputs.delivery != 'projects-g6-catalog' && !cancelled() && steps.select.outputs.slot_01 != '' && steps.module_01_budget.outputs.active == 'true' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.HEXALITH_CICD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: Hexalith
          repositories: ${{ steps.select.outputs.slot_01 }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-workflows: write
          permission-administration: ${{ steps.select.outputs.check_01 == 'true' && 'read' || '' }}

"""Closed, pre-adoption Projects catalog correction; no module code is executed.

The committed manifest binds the complete input/output trees and proposal bytes.
Only the network transport is replaceable by real-Git qualification fixtures.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_g6_delivery_runtime", Path(__file__).with_name("delivery_runtime.py"))
rt = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
sys.modules[_SPEC.name] = rt
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(rt)

PROJECTS = "Hexalith.Projects"
MANIFEST = "docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.json"
PATCH = "docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.patch"
WORKFLOW = ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
ACTION = ".github/actions/prepare-g6-catalog/"
PATHS = (WORKFLOW, ACTION + "action.yml", ACTION + "prepare.py")
SOURCES = ("tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py", "tools/delivery_runtime.py", MANIFEST, PATCH,
           ACTION + "action.yml", ACTION + "prepare.py")


class Git(rt.Git):
    """Keep bounded combined push diagnostics without changing the shared runtime."""
    def run(self, *args, **options):
        if not args or args[0] != "push":
            return super().run(*args, **options)
        token = options.get("token")
        require(token, "scoped Projects App token unavailable")
        self.budget.check(token=True)
        env = self.env.copy()
        header = base64.b64encode(("x-access-token:" + token).encode()).decode()
        rt._SECRETS.extend((token, header))
        index = int(env["GIT_CONFIG_COUNT"])
        env.update({"GIT_CONFIG_COUNT": str(index + 1), f"GIT_CONFIG_KEY_{index}": "http.https://github.com/.extraheader",
                    f"GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_{index}": "AUTHORIZATION: basic " + header})
        self.push_diagnostics = {"exit_code": None, "output": "", "timed_out": False}
        timeout = self.budget.timeout()
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as output:
            process = subprocess.Popen(["git", "-C", str(self.root), *map(str, args)],
                                       stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, start_new_session=True)
            try:
                process.wait(timeout=timeout)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                self.push_diagnostics["timed_out"] = True
                try:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass
                process.wait()
            output.seek(0)
            data = output.read(rt.MAX_GIT + 1)
        self.push_diagnostics.update(exit_code=process.returncode,
                                     output=rt.clean(data[:rt.MAX_GIT].decode("utf-8", "replace")))
        require(not self.push_diagnostics["timed_out"], "Git push timed out; remote outcome is ambiguous")
        require(len(data) <= rt.MAX_GIT, "Git push diagnostics exceed 16 MiB limit; remote outcome is ambiguous")
        return process.returncode, data


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise rt.DeliveryError(message)


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def manifest(data):
    value = rt.json_read(data)
    require(isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == {
        "schema", "repository", "base_commit", "base_tree", "patch_sha256", "result_tree", "before", "after", "pre_push_gate"},
        "invalid closed catalog delivery manifest")
    require(value["schema"] == "hexalith.projects-g6-catalog.v1" and value["repository"] == PROJECTS,
            "catalog delivery repository/schema mismatch")
    require(value["pre_push_gate"] in {"pending-owner-decision", "reviewed-tree-owner-authorized"},
            "invalid closed pre-push owner gate")
    for key in ("base_commit", "base_tree", "result_tree"):
        rt.sha(value[key])
    require(isinstance(value["patch_sha256"], str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", value["patch_sha256"]),
            "invalid proposal SHA256")
    for key in ("before", "after"):
        require(isinstance(value[key], dict) and set(value[key]) == set(PATHS), "unexpected manifest path")
        for path, item in value[key].items():
            if key == "before" and path != WORKFLOW:
                require(item is None, "catalog action must be absent at reviewed base")
            else:
                require(isinstance(item, list) and len(item) == 3 and item[:2] == ["100644", "blob"],
                        "catalog delivery requires regular nonexecutable blobs")
                rt.sha(item[2])
    return value


def entries(git, revision, expected):
    actual = git.items(revision)
    for path, item in expected.items():
        require(actual.get(path) == (tuple(item) if item else None), "unexpected catalog source blob/mode: " + path)
    return actual


def proposal(owner, source, target, value):
    patch = owner.blob(source, PATCH)
    require(digest(patch) == value["patch_sha256"], "reviewed proposal SHA256 mismatch")
    base = value["base_commit"]
    require(target.resolve(base + "^{tree}") == value["base_tree"], "reviewed base tree mismatch")
    before = entries(target, base, value["before"])
    target.run("read-tree", value["base_tree"])
    target.run("apply", "--cached", "--whitespace=nowarn", data=patch)
    tree = target.resolve(target.run("write-tree", "--missing-ok").decode().strip())
    require(tree == value["result_tree"], "complete proposal output tree mismatch")
    after = entries(target, tree, value["after"])
    changed = {path for path in set(before) | set(after) if before.get(path) != after.get(path)}
    require(changed == set(PATHS), "proposal changed paths outside the three-path correction")
    for path in PATHS[1:]:
        require(target.blob(tree, path) == owner.blob(source, path), "catalog action differs from owner payload")
    return tree


def plan(source, value, manifest_bytes, live):
    return {"schema": "hexalith.projects-g6-catalog-plan.v1", "owner_source": source,
            "manifest_sha256": digest(manifest_bytes), "patch_sha256": value["patch_sha256"],
            "pre_push_gate": value["pre_push_gate"],
            "base_commit": value["base_commit"], "base_tree": value["base_tree"],
            "result_tree": value["result_tree"], "observed_main": live}


def parents(git, revision):
    header = git.run("cat-file", "commit", revision).split(b"\n\n", 1)[0]
    return [line[7:].decode("ascii") for line in header.splitlines() if line.startswith(b"parent ")]


def exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, phase):
    """Prove this unregistered target is absent from both full-writer selectors."""
    proof = {"phase": phase, "owner_source": source, "registry_absent": None, "accepted_ref_absent": None,
             "advertised_main": None, "owner_main_matches_source": None}
    receipt["full_writer_exclusion"].append(proof)
    receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify Projects registry absence during " + phase
    registry = rt.registry(owner, source)
    registered = [name for name in registry if name.casefold() == PROJECTS.casefold()]
    proof.update(registry_count=len(registry), registry_sha256=digest(json.dumps(registry, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
                 registry_absent=not registered, matching_registry_entries=registered[:32])
    require(proof["registry_absent"], "Projects is present in the exact committed full-delivery registry")
    receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify atomic owner-main/accepted-ref advertisement during " + phase
    output = owner.run("ls-remote", "--heads", transport.remote(rt.CICD), "refs/heads/main", "refs/heads/delivered/*")
    proof.update(advertisement_sha256=digest(output), advertisement_bytes=len(output))
    refs = {}
    for row in output.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
        parts = row.split("\t")
        require(len(parts) == 2, "invalid live owner/ref advertisement row")
        revision, reference = parts
        revision = rt.sha(revision)
        if reference == "refs/heads/main":
            require(proof["advertised_main"] is None, "duplicate live owner main advertisement")
            proof["advertised_main"] = revision
            continue
        require(reference.startswith("refs/heads/delivered/"), "unexpected live owner/ref advertisement")
        name = rt.name(reference.removeprefix("refs/heads/delivered/"))
        require(reference not in refs, "duplicate live accepted ref")
        refs[reference] = (name, revision)
    require(proof["advertised_main"] is not None, "missing live owner main advertisement")
    proof["owner_main_matches_source"] = proof["advertised_main"] == source
    require(proof["owner_main_matches_source"], "advertised owner main differs from reviewed source")
    matches = [reference for reference, (name, _) in refs.items() if name.casefold() == PROJECTS.casefold()]
    proof.update(accepted_ref_count=len(refs), accepted_refs_sha256=digest(json.dumps(refs, sort_keys=True).encode()),
                 accepted_ref_absent=not matches, matching_accepted_refs=matches[:32])
    require(proof["accepted_ref_absent"], "Projects has a live full-delivery accepted ref")


def execute(operation, context, report_path, *, transport=None, token="", scratch=None, local_root=None):
    """Qualify or deliver using private objects/index, retaining bounded failure receipts."""
    rt._SECRETS.extend([token] if token else [])
    receipt = {"schema": "hexalith.projects-g6-catalog-delivery.v1", "operation": operation,
               "repository": PROJECTS, "owner_source": None,
               "status": "failed", "failed_operation": "authorize owner invocation", "reason": None,
               "observed_main": None, "delivered_sha": None, "delivered_tree": None,
               "candidate_sha": None, "candidate_tree": None, "push_attempted": False, "plan": None,
               "full_writer_exclusion": []}
    try:
        receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify secret-free behavioral suites"
        require(context.get("G6_BEHAVIORAL_RESULT", "success") == "success", "secret-free behavioral qualification failed or was skipped")
        receipt["failed_operation"] = "authorize owner invocation"
        require(context.get("GITHUB_REPOSITORY") == "Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd" and
                context.get("GITHUB_REF") == "refs/heads/main" and
                context.get("GITHUB_EVENT_NAME") == "workflow_dispatch", "ineligible narrow owner invocation")
        source = rt.sha(context.get("G6_OWNER_SOURCE"))
        receipt["owner_source"] = source
        require(source == context.get("GITHUB_SHA"), "owner source differs from dispatch source")
        if operation == "deliver":
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify successful secret-free qualification"
            require(context.get("G6_QUALIFICATION") == "success", "secret-free qualification did not succeed")
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "read qualified plan"
            qualified = rt.json_read(context.get("G6_PLAN", ""))
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "require scoped Projects App token"
            require(token, "scoped Projects App token unavailable")
        budget = rt.Budget()
        transport = transport or rt.Transport(budget)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="g6-owner-", dir=scratch) as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            owner = rt.Git(root / "owner.git", budget)
            owner.init()
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "fetch exact CiCd main"
            require(transport.module(owner, rt.CICD) == source, "owner source is not current exact CiCd main")
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify committed owner source and manifest"
            source_root = Path(local_root) if local_root else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
            for path in SOURCES:
                require((source_root / path).is_file() and not (source_root / path).is_symlink() and
                        (source_root / path).read_bytes() == owner.blob(source, path),
                        "local owner payload differs from exact committed source: " + path)
            raw = owner.blob(source, MANIFEST)
            value = manifest(raw)
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify source-bound pre-push owner gate"
            require(value["pre_push_gate"] == "reviewed-tree-owner-authorized", "pre-push gate is pending owner decision")
            exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, "qualification" if operation == "qualify" else "delivery source verification")
            target = Git(root / "projects.git", budget, index=root / "private-index")
            target.init()
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "fetch exact Projects main"
            live = transport.module(target, PROJECTS)
            receipt["observed_main"] = live
            # The base is fetched by exact object id when main is already the
            # delivered child. No checkout, submodule or module command runs.
            if live != value["base_commit"]:
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify already delivered exact tree and direct parent"
                require(target.resolve(live + "^{tree}") == value["result_tree"] and
                        parents(target, live) == [value["base_commit"]], "Projects main differs from reviewed base/result")
                target.run("fetch", "--depth=1", "--no-tags", "--no-recurse-submodules",
                           transport.remote(PROJECTS), value["base_commit"])
            receipt["failed_operation"] = "construct exact reviewed proposal"
            tree = proposal(owner, source, target, value)
            binding = plan(source, value, raw, live)
            receipt["plan"] = binding
            if operation == "deliver":
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "verify qualified source/proposal/main binding"
                require(qualified == binding, "qualified source/proposal/main binding mismatch")
            if operation == "qualify":
                receipt["status"] = "qualified"
            elif live != value["base_commit"]:
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact CiCd main before unchanged confirmation"
                require(transport.module(owner, rt.CICD) == source, "CiCd main advanced before unchanged confirmation")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main before unchanged confirmation"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced before unchanged confirmation")
                exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, "unchanged confirmation")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main after unchanged exclusion"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced during unchanged exclusion")
                receipt.update(status="unchanged", delivered_sha=live, delivered_tree=tree)
            else:
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "create direct child commit"
                commit = rt.sha(target.run("commit-tree", tree, "-p", live,
                    data=b"build(cicd): acquire reviewed Projects G-6 catalog\n").decode().strip())
                require(parents(target, commit) == [live], "delivery commit parent mismatch")
                receipt.update(candidate_sha=commit, candidate_tree=tree)
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact CiCd main before push"
                require(transport.module(owner, rt.CICD) == source, "CiCd main advanced before push")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main before push"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced before push")
                exclude_full_writer(owner, source, transport, receipt, "push")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "reread exact Projects main after push exclusion"
                require(transport.module(target, PROJECTS) == live, "Projects main advanced during push exclusion")
                receipt["failed_operation"] = "git push " + commit + ":refs/heads/main"
                receipt["push_attempted"] = True
                try:
                    code, output = transport.push(target, PROJECTS, commit, token)
                    receipt["push_result"] = {"exit_code": code, "output": rt.clean(output.decode("utf-8", "replace"))}
                    require(code == 0, "non-forced Projects push failed; remote outcome may be ambiguous; no retry or reapply")
                except Exception:
                    if "push_result" not in receipt and hasattr(target, "push_diagnostics"):
                        receipt["push_result"] = target.push_diagnostics
                    try:
                        observed = transport.module(target, PROJECTS)

                    except Exception as error:

                        "Projects main changed after push")

    except Exception as error:
        receipt["reason"] = rt.clean(error) if isinstance(error, rt.DeliveryError) else "catalog owner operation failed: " + type(error).__name__
    rt.atomic(Path(report_path), receipt)
    return receipt


def main(argv=None, *, transport=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("operation", choices=("qualify", "deliver"))
    parser.add_argument("--report", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    context = os.environ.copy()
    tokens = rt.sanitize()
    result = execute(args.operation, context, args.report, transport=transport,
                     token=tokens["MODULE_TOKEN"], scratch=context.get("TMPDIR"))
    if args.operation == "qualify" and result["status"] == "qualified" and context.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"):
        with open(context["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write("plan=" + json.dumps(result["plan"], separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    return 0 if result["status"] in {"qualified", "unchanged", "delivered"} else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.12"
# dependencies = ["PyYAML==6.0.3"]
# ///
"""Execute real workflow mappings; replace external actions and I/O boundaries.

The controller and immutable bootstrap commands execute in isolated Python
children. Git fixtures use real remotes and the released v5.1.0 library; this
harness does not replace scripts with expected reports or a perimeter stand-in.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

import yaml
from delivery_support import ROOT, Workspace, bootstrap_source, git


class Workflow:
    def __init__(self, workspace, *, ref="refs/heads/main", event="push", validation="success", verdict=None,
                 mint_fail=(), cancel_after=None, delivery="full", g6_plan=None, job="deliver",
                 suite_result="success", checkout_fail=False):
        self.w = workspace
        self.document = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github/workflows/deliver.yml").read_bytes())
        self.job = self.document["jobs"][job]
        self.job_name = job
        self.suite_result = suite_result
        self.checkout_fail = checkout_fail
        self.context = {"github": {"ref": ref, "sha": workspace.sha, "repository": "Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd",
            "workspace": str(workspace.root), "run_id": "101", "run_attempt": "1", "event_name": event, "token": "inert-checkout-token"},
            "needs": {"validate": {"result": validation, "outputs": {"verdict": json.dumps(verdict) if verdict is not None else ""}}},
            "steps": {}, "inputs": {"delivery": delivery}, "runner": {"temp": str(workspace.root)},
            "secrets": {"HEXALITH_CICD_APP_PRIVATE_KEY": "inert-no-private-key"},
            "vars": {"HEXALITH_CICD_APP_CLIENT_ID": "inert-client-id"}}
        # Model validation at its I/O boundary, then evaluate the real job's
        # output mapping even when that job's result is failure.
        self.context["steps"] = {"validate": {"outputs": self.context["needs"]["validate"]["outputs"]},
                                 "g6_qualify": {"outputs": {"plan": json.dumps(g6_plan) if g6_plan else ""}}}
        self.context["needs"]["validate"]["outputs"] = {
            key: self.expand(value) for key, value in self.document["jobs"]["validate"].get("outputs", {}).items()}
        self.context["steps"] = {}
        self.mint_fail = set(mint_fail)
        self.actions, self.commands, self.uploads = [], [], []
        self.failed = False
        self.cancelled = validation == "cancelled"
        self.cancel_after = cancel_after
        self.mints, self.processes, self.checkouts = [], [], []

    def lookup(self, path):
        value = self.context
        for part in path.split("."):
            value = value.get(part, "") if isinstance(value, dict) else ""
        return value

    def expression(self, value):
        value = value.strip()
        if value.startswith("${{"):
            value = value[3:-2].strip()
        tokens = re.findall(r"'(?:[^']|'')*'|[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*|&&|\|\||==|!=|!|\(|\)|,", value)
        result = []
        for token in tokens:
            if token.startswith("'"):
                result.append(repr(token[1:-1]))
            elif token in {"&&", "||", "!"}:
                result.append({"&&": "and", "||": "or", "!": "not"}[token])
            elif token in {"==", "!=", "(", ")", ","}:
                result.append(token)
            elif token in {"always", "success", "failure", "cancelled", "format"}:
                result.append(token)
            elif token in {"true", "false"}:
                result.append("True" if token == "true" else "False")
            else:
                result.append(repr(self.lookup(token)))
        return eval(" ".join(result), {"__builtins__": {}}, {"always": lambda: True,
            "success": lambda: not self.failed and not self.cancelled, "failure": lambda: self.failed, "cancelled": lambda: self.cancelled,
            "format": lambda pattern, value: pattern.format(value)})

    def expand(self, value):
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            return value
        return re.sub(r"\$\{\{(.*?)\}\}", lambda m: str(self.expression(m.group(1))), value)

    def condition(self, value):
        # GitHub inserts success() unless an explicit status function occurs.
        if not re.search(r"\b(?:always|cancelled|failure|success)\s*\(", value):
            if self.failed or self.cancelled:
                return False
        return self.expression(value)

    def finish_step(self, identifier, step, outcome, outputs):
        self.context["steps"][identifier] = {"outcome": outcome, "outputs": outputs}
        if outcome == "failure" and not step.get("continue-on-error", False):
            self.failed = True
        if self.cancel_after is not None and self.cancel_after in (identifier, step.get("name")):
            self.cancelled = True

    def execute(self):
        triggers = self.document.get("on", self.document.get(True))
        event, ref = self.context["github"]["event_name"], self.context["github"]["ref"]
        if event not in triggers or (event == "push" and ref.removeprefix("refs/heads/") not in triggers["push"]["branches"]):
            return "not-triggered"
        concurrency = self.document["concurrency"]
        self.concurrency_group = self.expression(concurrency["group"])
        self.cancel_in_progress = self.expression(concurrency["cancel-in-progress"])
        writer = self.job.get("concurrency")
        self.writer_concurrency_group = self.expand(writer["group"]) if writer else None
        self.writer_cancel_in_progress = self.expand(writer["cancel-in-progress"]) if writer else None
        self.validation_entered = True
        if not self.condition(self.job.get("if", "success()")):
            return "skipped"
        base = self.w.env()
        if self.job_name == "validate":
            base.pop("MODULE_TOKEN", None)
            base.pop("CICD_TOKEN", None)
        base.update({"GITHUB_" + key.upper(): str(value) for key, value in self.context["github"].items() if key != "token"})
        base.update({key: self.expand(value) for key, value in self.job.get("env", {}).items()})
        self.context["env"] = base
        for ordinal, step in enumerate(self.job["steps"]):
            identifier = step.get("id", f"step_{ordinal}")
            if not self.condition(step.get("if", "success()")):
                self.context["steps"][identifier] = {"outcome": "skipped", "outputs": {}}
                continue
            outputs, outcome = {}, "success"
            if "uses" in step:
                inputs = {key: self.expand(value) for key, value in step.get("with", {}).items()}
                self.actions.append((step["uses"], inputs))
                action = step["uses"].split("@", 1)[0]
                if action == "actions/checkout":
                    source = inputs.get("ref", "")
                    if self.job_name == "validate":
                        # Candidate bytes already exist in this real Git fixture;
                        # only the external checkout action is substituted.
                        if step.get("id") == "cicd" and self.checkout_fail:
                            outcome = "failure"
                        self.checkouts.append(inputs)
                        self.finish_step(identifier, step, outcome, outputs)
                        continue
                    if inputs.get("path") == ".g6-owner":
                        if self.checkout_fail:
                            self.finish_step(identifier, step, "failure", outputs)
                            continue
                        if source != self.w.sha or inputs.get("persist-credentials") is not False or inputs.get("submodules") is not False:
                            raise AssertionError("narrow checkout changed qualified source/credentials")
                        destination = self.w.root / inputs["path"]
                        paths = git(self.w.candidate, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", source).splitlines()
                        selected = [path for path in paths if any(path == prefix or path.startswith(prefix + "/")
                                    for prefix in inputs["sparse-checkout"].splitlines())]
                        for path in selected:
                            target = destination / path
                            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                            target.write_bytes(subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.w.candidate), "show",
                                                source + ":" + path], check=True, capture_output=True).stdout)
                        self.checkouts.append(sorted(selected))
                        self.finish_step(identifier, step, outcome, outputs)
                        continue
                    anchor = json.loads((ROOT / "tools/tests/fixtures/delivery-bootstrap.json").read_bytes())
                    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", source) or source != anchor["source_sha"]:
                        raise AssertionError("selector checkout is not immutable")
                    if inputs.get("persist-credentials") is not False or inputs.get("submodules") is not False:
                        raise AssertionError("unsafe checkout")
                    destination = self.w.root / inputs["path"]
                    for path in inputs.get("sparse-checkout", "").splitlines():
                        if not path or path.startswith("/") or ".." in Path(path).parts:
                            raise AssertionError("noncanonical sparse path")
                        data = bootstrap_source(source, path)
                        if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != anchor["files"][path]:
                            raise AssertionError("bootstrap bytes do not match immutable source manifest")
                        target = destination / path
                        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        target.write_bytes(data)
                    self.checkouts.append(sorted(p.relative_to(destination).as_posix()
                                                 for p in destination.rglob("*") if p.is_file()))
                elif action == "actions/create-github-app-token":
                    repository = inputs.get("repositories")
                    self.mints.append((identifier, inputs.copy()))
                    if inputs.get("owner") != "Hexalith" or not repository or "," in repository or "\n" in repository:
                        raise AssertionError("mint broadened beyond one explicit repository")
                    if inputs.get("permission-contents") != "write" or inputs.get("permission-workflows") != "write":
                        raise AssertionError("mint lacks required Contents/Workflows write permissions")
                    if repository == "Hexalith.CiCd" and inputs.get("permission-actions") != "read":
                        raise AssertionError("CiCd mint lacks Actions read permission")
                    if repository in self.mint_fail:
                        outcome = "failure"
                    else:
                        outputs["token"] = "inert-token-" + repository
                elif action == "actions/upload-artifact":
                    artifact = Path(inputs["path"])
                    if not artifact.is_absolute():
                        artifact = self.w.root / artifact
                    if not artifact.is_file():
                        self.finish_step(identifier, step, "failure", outputs)
                        continue
                    self.uploads.append((inputs["name"], artifact.read_bytes()))
                elif action == "astral-sh/setup-uv" and self.job_name == "validate":
                    pass
                else:
                    raise AssertionError("unhandled external action " + action)
            elif "run" in step:
                if identifier == "g6_tests" and self.job_name == "validate":
                    self.finish_step(identifier, step, self.suite_result, outputs)
                    continue
                command = shlex.split(step["run"])
                if command[2:3] in ([".g6-owner/tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py"], ["tools/deliver_g6_catalog.py"]):
                    command[command.index("--report") + 1] = str(self.w.root / command[command.index("--report") + 1])
                if command[:2] != ["python3", "-I"] or "${{" in step["run"]:
                    raise AssertionError("privileged command is not isolated Python")
                self.commands.append(command)
                self.w.outputs.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                env = base | {key: self.expand(value) for key, value in step.get("env", {}).items()}
                if command[3:4] == ["module"]:
                    self.processes.append({"name": step["name"], "slot": int(command[command.index("--slot") + 1]),
                                           "token": env.get("MODULE_TOKEN", "")})
                source = self.w.candidate / command[2] if self.job_name == "validate" else self.w.root / command[2]
                result = self.w.call(str(source), command[3:], env=env) if source.is_file() else 1
                if result:
                    outcome = "failure"
                if self.w.outputs.exists():
                    outputs = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in self.w.outputs.read_text().splitlines())
            else:
                raise AssertionError("step has neither action nor command")
            self.finish_step(identifier, step, outcome, outputs)
        return "failure" if self.failed else "success"

# Projects G-6 catalog acquisition proposal

The CiCd-owned action in `.github/actions/prepare-g6-catalog/` corrects the missing
catalog object reported by [Projects run 43881420098](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Projects/actions/runs/43881420098).
It belongs before Conversations `prepare-build`, after the direct dependencies
have been initialized. The mapper remains unchanged and performs no acquisition.

The caller supplies the full Platform revision from its committed direct gitlink.
The helper requires that revision to match Platform HEAD and the staged outer
gitlink. It derives the catalog commit from that revision's Builds gitlink,
requires the canonical root Builds declaration and effective origin, and fetches
only a missing exact commit with `--no-recurse-submodules --no-tags --depth=1`.
It verifies the commit and regular catalog blob, reports the exact bytes/hash,
and compares HEAD, raw index bytes, entries, refs and gitlinks before and after,
including on fetch failure. Git runs with isolated environment/configuration;
transport overrides and symlinked dependency paths are rejected. Timed-out Git
process groups are terminated and waited for before preservation is checked.
The action retains JSON and prints only bounded failure diagnostics.

Run its behavioral qualification from this repository:

```bash
run-with-temp python3 -B tools/tests/test_prepare_g6_catalog.py
run-with-temp uv run --locked --script --python 3.12 tools/tests/test_prepare_g6_catalog.py
```

Tests use synthetic repositories and a local transport substitution only at the
fetch boundary. The separate real-source proof retained in Folders uses the
production helper and approved GitHub Builds origin without substitution. It
starts with a depth-one Builds checkout, proves the selected commit missing,
acquires it, compares exact catalog bytes, and checks unchanged HEAD/index,
gitlinks and refs plus an idempotent second invocation. These tests qualify
acquisition only; they do not execute the mapper, restore or runtime G-6.

## Reviewed integration

`docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.patch` is the retained reviewed owner proposal.
It adds the local action and inserts its invocation before the existing restore
step in Projects source `4511105bb1f00b8cf762097523de74acc828a001`. The revision is
derived at execution from Projects HEAD; the historical catalog commit is never
hardcoded. All existing dependency pins and product gates are preserved.

The supported writer, `tools/deliver.py:apply_module`, requires a valid accepted
`delivered/Hexalith.Projects` ref and applies an entire rendered perimeter.
Projects is absent from `setup/` and has no observed accepted ref. The generic CI
template has no G-6 preparation extension. `templates/perimeter.json.j2` owns the
whole workflows directory and enforces the Builds pin from `builds-version`
(currently `v6.0.6`); enabling that delivery would perform the separately planned
Projects adoption in CiCd Story 18 and change policy/pins beyond this correction.

## Closed pre-adoption delivery exception

The `projects-g6-catalog` dispatch choice in the existing `deliver.yml` is a
task-specific AD-6 exception for this source-preparation correction. It keeps
AD-7's existing main-only `deliver` job, `cicd-app` environment and pinned App
action. Only main + workflow_dispatch + projects-g6-catalog uses the scoped
`deliver-projects-g6-catalog` concurrency group. Normal main/default runs retain
`deliver`; non-main validation groups and cancellation behavior stay unchanged.
Validation lanes run independently. Both modes' existing `deliver` job uses the
shared `deliver-owned-writes` job mutex with cancellation disabled, so their write
phases serialize. This key differs from the workflow-level `deliver` key.
It neither registers Projects nor
creates an accepted ref, resolves a Builds version, or applies a rendered
perimeter. The architecture document and Story 1.17 tracking are unchanged.

The closed manifest `docs/proposals/projects-g6-catalog.json` binds Projects base
`4511105bb1f00b8cf762097523de74acc828a001`, its entire tree, the reviewed patch
SHA256, every input/output path and blob, and complete output tree
`c5425f42f16a8fe328ae5ec9f7c3d3ad81bd0047`. The only output changes are
`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/actions/prepare-g6-catalog/action.yml` and
`.github/actions/prepare-g6-catalog/prepare.py`. The action bytes are reused
unchanged. Acquisition precedes Conversations prepare-build; the mapper stays
offline and fail-closed. All pins, product gates and other tree entries survive
byte for byte.

The manifest also binds `pre_push_gate`. On 2026-11-16 the owner responded
“fix” to the explicit request to authorize the reviewed-tree gate for this exact
three-file correction. Its production value is therefore
`reviewed-tree-owner-authorized`. That decision applies only to the base,
proposal and complete result tree above. It does not alter the normal checker,
adoption policy, dependency pins, credentials or any module product gate.
Any unexpected source or proposal still fails closed before delivery.

The secret-free validation job runs the acquisition, narrow delivery and existing
workflow behavioral suites, then constructs a plan from current exact CiCd main
and current Projects main in private bare Git repositories. That JSON output
binds qualification to the writer's source, manifest, patch, base and result
tree. Failed qualification, a missing plan or a non-main/non-dispatch invocation
prevents the narrow write job from running. Normal triggers and the default
`full` choice retain the existing delivery behavior.

including case variants of its repository name. Only committed tree metadata and

exactly one main SHA equal to the reviewed owner source. Accepted histories and

controller requires the reviewed workflow, action, manifest and patch blobs to
be available and verified. Unchanged promised blob contents may remain missing;

changed source, bytes, trees, missing required blobs, symlinks,
unexpected modes or extra paths before writing. It rereads owner and module main,
makes one non-forced push, then rereads the actual main SHA/tree. Refusal or a
race is retained with the exact failed operation, without retry, force, rebase
or automatic reapplication. An exact delivered tree with the reviewed base as
its sole direct parent is an idempotent no-op.

The owner invocation, after publishing and qualifying the task-owned CiCd source
and recording the exact-source owner authorization, is:

```bash
gh workflow run deliver.yml --repo Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd --ref main \
  -f delivery=projects-g6-catalog
```

Dispatch through the existing scoped CiCd profile. If the App installation cannot
mint the Projects token, retain GitHub's failed mint step and the failed delivery

`projects-g6-qualification` and `projects-g6-delivery` JSON artifacts for 90 days.

delivered SHA/tree, push result and exact failed operation.

`python3 references/Hexalith.Builds/check.py` exits 1 because
`.github/hexalith-ci.json` is absent; the original failure remains retained.
The owner's exact-source exception permits this pre-adoption CiCd operation to
use its qualified reviewed-tree gate. It does not authorize adding adoption
configuration, suppressing the normal checker, or weakening a product gate.
After successful delivery, inspect Projects' exact three-path
diff and collect fresh CI/G-6 logs and artifacts tied to its delivered SHA.
Diagnose any subsequent hosted failure separately from catalog acquisition.
Publishing, A8 audit, deployment and v2 activation remain outside this correction.

Retained proof and full source identities are in Folders:
`_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/evidence/story-1-17-g6-catalog-acquisition-2026-11-16/`.
The historical publication/audit/A8 work and Story 1.17 tracking are unchanged.

The original proposal also applied to Projects `981ceef13a1abc88219925e73c51a23eb9ac50c2`. Concurrent product preparation advanced it to `4511105bb1f00b8cf762097523de74acc828a001`; fresh private-Git qualification rebound only the base/tree/result identities.
